column3: LEAD — Easton Press & Franklin Library leather editions, 127 vols; type 3; est. resale $2,500–4,000 ($20–35/vol sold); $1 = make-offer placeholder, get the real ask; key titles (signed/limited, Great Books, 100 Greatest) sell singly, rest as one lot; several Civic loads

LEAD — Vintage Kenner Star Wars loose figures 1977–83 (~12: Chewbacca, C-3PO, R5-D4, Greedo, Stormtroopers, Leia/Luke); type 3; est. resale $150–250 ($10–25 each sold loose); $25 asks for whole lot; CHECK PHOTOS for weapons and Hong Kong/Taiwan leg marks

LEAD — WWE Shop Championship Commemorative Title Belt (adult metal-plate replica, ~$500 retail); type 3; est. resale $250–350 used sold; $75 ask; CHECK PHOTOS it is the heavy metal-plate commemorative, not the Mattel kids toy belt
LEAD — Avant Garde magazine (Ginzburg/Lubalin, 1968–71) complete run #1–14; type 3; est. resale $800–1,500 for full run; $150 ask is well under half; confirm all 14 issues present and covers intact
LEAD — Canon AE-1 35mm SLR with flash (and lens?); type 3; est. resale $180–250 working with 50mm FD lens; $85 ask; CHECK lens included and shutter has no squeal
LEAD — James Avery sterling charm bracelet (dove + ornament charms look JA); type 1; est. resale $150–300; $0 ask = offer; hunch — CHECK PHOTOS for JA hallmark on charms and clasp
LEAD — LEGO minifigure lot ~80+ figs (Ninjago/City/Friends mix); type 3; est. resale $160–300 ($2–4/fig); $1 = make offer; CHECK genuine LEGO stamp on neck stud, not knockoffs
LEAD — Nintendo 3DS game cart lot x8 (Pokemon, Smash Bros, Paper Mario, Mario 3D Land, Kirby etc.); type 3; est. resale $150–220 ($15–35 each sold); $1 = make offer; check titles and authentic carts

LEAD — CHECK PHOTOS (hunch, <$20): red silk bomber w/ gold-chain & rope baroque print = 80s/90s Escada or Versace-style designer silk; type 1; est. resale $80–200 if labelled Escada/Versace (unbranded ~$25); check neck label + fabric tag
LEAD — LEGO Bionicle lot ~20 figures (Toa Mata/Nuva, Bohrok, Matoran visible); type 3; est. resale $90–150 (Bionicle figures sell ~$5–10 each, lots of 20 ~$100); $10 ask, sell as one lot

LEAD — CHECK PHOTOS: jewelry/craft lot with large turquoise cabochon piece visible = possible sterling Native American (Navajo/Zuni) pendant/cuff; type 4; est. resale $80–250 if marked sterling; look for 925/Sterling stamp or hallmark on the turquoise piece

LEAD — Minolta X-series SLR (X-700/X-570/X-370) with MD zoom lens, titled only "Camera (Film)"; type 1; est. resale $90–180 (X-700 kit ~$150, X-370 ~$80); $25 ask, Keller 0mi; check top-plate model name

LEAD — Mobile Fidelity UHQR (Ultra High Quality Record) 200g boxed LP, 1981–82; type 3; est. resale $150–500 depending on title (Supertramp/Steely Dan ~$150, Sgt Pepper ~$400, DSOTM $1,000+); $30 ask is well under half; check which title and box/inserts complete

LEAD — DOWN: "porcelain doll" photo shows antique German china-head doll (black molded hair, cloth body), c.1860–1900; type 2; est. resale $75–250 (china heads sell $75–300, more for low-brow/early hairstyles); check shoulder head for cracks/repairs and marked size number

LEAD — CHECK PHOTOS: Lionel Barrymore original etchings (he was a published etcher), set of 4 framed, $25; type 3; est. resale $150–400 for the set if pencil-signed originals (singles $75–200), ~$30 if halftone repros; check pencil signature + plate mark under glass

LEAD — 10K gold Cuban/Miami link chain/bracelet weighing ~30 g on photographed scale; type 3; est. resale ~$1,200–1,500 (30 g 10K ≈ 12.5 g fine, melt well over $1,000) vs $390 ask; high fake/plated risk — require 10K + maker stamp and meet at a jeweler to test before paying

LEAD — Hank Williams Sr. MGM LP lot (26 albums); type 3; est. resale $150-250 as lot; MGM-era Hank LPs typically sell $8-15 each, $50 ask = under $2/album; CHECK PHOTOS for original MGM yellow/black labels vs reissues

LEAD — 1940s-50s Rand McNally Elf / Whitman Tell-a-Tale children's book lot (Alley Oop, I Have a Turtle, Sally Squirrel, Animal 1-2-3); type 2; est. resale $60-100 as lot; "rare vintage books" at $1 = offer price, vintage illustrated kids' books sell $4-10 each; HUNCH, count the lot

LEAD — LEGO Star Wars collection (several boxed sets plus many built ships/vehicles, minifigs); type 3/4; est. resale $300-800; $1 placeholder = make offer, used LEGO Star Wars lots of this size typically sell $300+; CHECK PHOTOS for retired/UCS sets and minifig count

LEAD — 58 boxed collector Barbies (1990s Holiday/collector series, NRFB); type 3; est. resale $400-700 for the lot (typical $8-15 each boxed); $20 ask — CONFIRM $20 is for all 58, not per doll (per-doll = pass)

LEAD — Indian Kamdhenu cow-and-calf silver idol (puja piece) titled "metal ornament"; type 1/2; est. resale $100-300 if solid 925/999 silver by weight (plated = ~$15); FREE so passes price; HUNCH — CHECK PHOTOS for 925/999 stamp under base

LEAD — L.M. Montgomery "Rilla of Ingleside" (1921 Stokes/McClelland first) in an 8-book early-1900s lot, plus other period cloth titles; 2/4; est. resale $120–250 for the lot; the red cloth "Rilla" spine visible, and a 1921 first sells $75–200 alone vs $65 for all 8. CHECK PHOTOS: title page date/publisher on Rilla and the green/blue cloth volumes.

LEAD — Jellycat plush lot (~8 pcs: Bashful Bunnies, Bashful elephant, hippo and others); 3; est. resale $120–160; used Jellycats typically sell $12–25 each on eBay/FB, and the whole lot is $25. Confirm the Jellycat tags.

LEAD — vintage Fisher-Price wooden pull toys, lot of 4 (musical roller, duck/turtle pull toys with litho paper labels); 3; est. resale $80–150; pre-1965 wood-and-litho Fisher-Price pulls sell $20–60 each vs $25 for the lot. HUNCH, CHECK PHOTOS: model numbers/dates on the bottoms, paper intact.

LEAD — signed middle-grade hardcovers (Max Brallier "Last Kids on Earth", Stuart Gibbs, Pablo Cartaya and others, 5 books); 3; est. resale $75–110; signed copies typically sell $15–25 each vs $10. HUNCH: confirm $10 is for the set and the signatures are real autographs, not bookplates.

LEAD — LEGO Disney 43231 Asha's Cottage (Wish) plus other Disney sets, complete with instructions; 3; est. resale $45–60 for 43231 alone (retired); typical sold $40–60 vs $10. CHECK: whether $10 is per set or for all, and completeness.
LEAD — Disney Store Classic 12" Ursula and King Triton dolls, NIB, retired; 3; est. resale $110–140 the pair; Ursula NRFB typically sells $55–75 and Triton $45–65 vs $60 for both.

LEAD — MSD 6AL Digital ignition box (PN 6425) in box with harness, in a "lots of stuff" $1 listing; 4; est. resale $110–180; used 6425 boxes typically sell $110–180 on eBay. Price is a $1 placeholder: message for his real price and offer under $50.

LEAD — Nintendo DS Pokemon games x4: Pokemon Black, Pokemon White, Pokemon Pearl and a red-label Pokemon title (Mystery Dungeon/Ranger); 3; est. resale $140–170; loose Black and White typically sell $45–60 each, Pearl $25–35, vs $50 for all four. CHECK PHOTOS: the backs of the carts (real ones have the NTR/TWL code embossed and a Nintendo board) because fakes are common.

LEAD — adidas France 2006 World Cup away (white) shirt, Zidane #10; 1/3; est. resale $100–200 if authentic; typical sold for a genuine 2006 Zidane is $100–250 vs $50. CHECK PHOTOS: the inner wash tag with the adidas product code, plus the stitching on the crest, because fakes are common.

LEAD — designer cologne lot (~8 bottles incl. Dolce & Gabbana, Versace, Carolina Herrera-style boxes); 3; est. resale $150–300; partial designer bottles typically sell $25–60 each vs $50 for the lot. CHECK PHOTOS: brands and fill levels on each bottle.

LEAD — Pacific Northwest/Alaska Native hand-carved painted totem (Sitka, thunderbird top); type 3; est. resale $100–250 if artist-signed vs $25 ask; CHECK PHOTOS for carver signature/Tlingit name on back or silver-hand Native tag (unsigned tourist ones $30–50)

LEAD — Homer Laughlin Fiesta dinnerware stack (plates, bowls, platters, multiple colours); type 1/3; est. resale $150–300 local as a set (Fiesta plates sell $8–15 each) at FREE; CHECK PHOTOS for HLC Fiesta backstamp and ringed rims, not a Mainstays knockoff

LEAD — large Hasbro 12in G.I. Joe uniform/weapon/accessory lot; type 4; est. resale $300–600 if 1964–69 Hasbro-marked pieces (vintage accessories $5–40 each, lots sell $300+) vs $150 ask; CHECK PHOTOS for Hasbro marks vs 1990s/21st Century Toys reissues

LEAD — 7 leather/gilt classics (Sherlock Holmes, Robin Hood, House at Pooh Corner, Lord of the Rings) possibly Easton Press/Folio-type fine bindings; type 1; est. resale $200–350 if Easton ($30–60 each sold) vs $65 ask, Keller 0mi; CHECK PHOTOS for raised spine hubs, moire endpapers, Easton/Franklin imprint (B&N leatherette = pass)
LEAD — LEGO Star Wars Millennium Falcon (likely 75257, with minifigs); type 3; typical sold $90–130 used complete vs $40 ask (under half); CHECK set number and minifigs present

LEAD — cluster/halo diamond-look ring on white metal, listed FREE/"Ring"; type 1; hunch: if 14K white gold w/ diamonds est. resale $150–400; CHECK PHOTOS for 14K/585 stamp inside shank — may be placeholder price, 47mi needs notice

LEAD — LEGO Ninjago retired boxed sets (~6 boxes visible, incl. larger playsets); type 3; est. resale $300–500 for the group; retired boxed Ninjago sets typically sell $50–150 each complete, ask $150 for all. CHECK PHOTOS: read set numbers, confirm complete w/ minifigs.

LEAD — vintage Japanese Gogatsu musha ningyo (mounted samurai on horse, Boys' Day doll); type 3; est. resale $120–250; mounted samurai May dolls in this finish typically sell $100–250 on eBay, ask $45. CHECK PHOTOS: silk armour, no cracks to gofun face, original stand.

LEAD — Coach signature-canvas wristlet/pouch, pink/chalk C pattern (Nolita 19-style) with charm; type 3; est. resale $60–110; Coach Nolita/signature pouches typically sell $60–110, listed FREE. CHECK PHOTOS: creed patch/serial, hardware stamped COACH.

LEAD — NHRA Fall Nationals (Texas Motorplex) graphic racing tees x2; type 3; est. resale $60–120 pair if 1990s; vintage 90s single-stitch NHRA tees typically sell $35–70 each, ask $10. HUNCH — CHECK tags/hems for single stitch and dated print.

LEAD — Farah Talib Aziz (Pakistani luxury designer) embellished yellow kurta/sharara set; type 3; est. resale $150–400; pre-owned FTA formals typically resell $150–400 in South Asian resale groups (retail $500+), ask shown $1 = offer. CHECK real ask, size, label; niche buyer market.

LEAD — pile of Victorian cabinet cards/CDVs and early Texas photos & ephemera; type 4; est. resale $75–200; Texas-photographer-backstamped cabinet cards and occupational/town views sell $10–40 each, ask $1. HUNCH — CHECK backs for Texas studio stamps, RPPC town views, tintypes.

LEAD — DOWN: "vintage book" = Cassell/Doré illustrated folio Milton's Paradise Lost, ed. Robert Vaughan (c.1866–1890s); type 2; est. resale $100–250; Doré folio Paradise Lost typically sells $100–250 even worn, ask $45. CHECK PHOTOS: Doré plates intact, boards attached.

LEAD — Feynman Lectures on Physics (Feynman/Leighton/Sands, Addison-Wesley red set); type 3; est. resale $100–400; 3-vol set sells $90–150 (New Millennium) to $300+ (1963–65 first printings), ask $40. CHECK PHOTOS: one volume or full set, copyright page date.

LEAD — TaylorMade P790 iron set (4-PW + AW); type 3; est. resale $350–600; P790 sets typically sell $350–600 by generation, ask shown $1 = make offer. Worth it only at an offer ≤$250. CHECK generation, shafts, grips.

LEAD — CHECK PHOTOS: Door of Hope Mission (Shanghai) carved pearwood-head Chinese dolls in cloth costume, or 1930s-40s Chinese clay figures; type 1; est. resale $300-1,200 for the group; seller calls them only "1940s collectible dolls" at $150. Door of Hope dolls typically sell for $250-800 each. Look for carved wooden heads and hands, hand-sewn silk/cotton clothes, about 11 in tall

LEAD — CHECK PHOTOS, hunch: Franklin Mint sterling medal or ingot albums (navy leatherette with gold stamping and date ranges); types 2/4; est. resale $200-800 by silver weight if filled; titled "coin collecting books" at $20. Filled Franklin Mint sterling sets sell at roughly melt or more. Ask whether medals are inside and look for the .925 sterling mark

LEAD — Telfar Small Shopping Bag in tan/cream vegan leather; type 3; est. resale $90-140; listed $0 (free or open offer). Typical used sold price is about $100-150. Check for a fake: embossed T logo, interior tag and stitching

LEAD — LEGO Star Wars built display sets (Millennium Falcon, AT-AT, Slave I-type ships, minifig dioramas) in a cabinet; type 3/4; est. resale $300-600 for the sets; "$1" means make an offer, so ask the real price and set numbers. Built Falcon/AT-AT sets each sell ~$100-200 used. Cabinet excluded. Plano 31mi.

LEAD — Charles Dickens 1911 multi-volume set (~25-30 red cloth volumes; CHECK PHOTOS for publisher: Scribner/Chapman & Hall Gadshill/Collier/Nickerson); type 3; est. resale $200-350 locally; ask is $100. Complete period Dickens sets usually sell $200-400, and book sets are a priority. Check the spines for completeness and condition.

LEAD — TaylorMade fairway woods/hybrids plus bag ("Golf Clubs For Sale", listed $0); type 1/3; est. resale $120-250 for the woods alone. Used TaylorMade fairway woods sell ~$50-90 each. Free/$0, so the price rule passes; ask whether the $0 is real. Dallas 27mi.

LEAD — LEGO bulk lot: about 8-10 lb sorted by colour in bags, plus a set, for $1; type 3; est. resale $80-150 (bulk LEGO sells ~$8-12/lb). Seller is pricing to dump. Check for Duplo/Mega Bloks and confirm the $1 price. Springtown 26mi.

LEAD — LEGO Star Wars R2-D2 75308 (2,314 pcs, retired; title just says "Lego Figure"); type 1/3; est. resale $140-190 used complete (retail was $199.99); ask is $60, well under half. Display plaque and mini R2 are shown. Check completeness and the dome. Fort Worth 14mi.

LEAD — Easton Press leather classics (seller's photo shows Easton Press Anna Karenina comps); type 3; est. resale $30-60 per volume, sets more; ask is $45. Easton Press 100 Greatest Books volumes typically sell $25-60 each. CHECK whether the $45 covers several volumes or one, and check the titles. Desoto 32mi (needs notice).

LEAD — Creed Millesime fragrance (box shows Creed crest + "MILLESIME"; likely Aventus/Green Irish Tweed/Silver Mountain Water 100ml); type 1 (title "Fall cologne sale"); est. resale $150-250 eBay used/partial; $30 ask is far under half of typical $200+ sold. CHECK PHOTOS: which scent, fill level, batch code (fakes common).

LEAD — Full-quill ostrich western boots, mens 8 (raised quill bumps on vamp; possibly Lucchese/Tony Lama/Anderson Bean/Rios of Mercedes); type 1 (title just "Men's boots"); est. resale $150-300 (big-maker full quill), ~$100 if Mexican Los Altos/Cuadra; $45 ask. CHECK PHOTOS: maker stamp inside shaft, real quill vs embossed print.

LEAD — Lot of ~35 vintage juvenile series hardcovers (Grosset & Dunlap era: Johnny King Quarterback, Football Twins, Gambling Halfback, A Child's Garden of Verses); 4; est. resale $120–200 as lot or picked singles; $20 for the stack, sports/series juveniles with jackets sell $5–15 each — CHECK PHOTOS for DJs, Chip Hilton/Hardy Boys picture covers

LEAD — LEGO Stranger Things 75810 The Upside Down (Creel House) if genuine; 1; est. resale $180–230 used complete; $75 is under half; title says only "building block set" — CHECK PHOTOS for LEGO on studs/box (clone risk)

LEAD — Crate of ~40 classic-rock LPs sold as "wall art" for $10; 2; est. resale $150–300 as a lot (classic rock LPs $5–25 each); hunch under $20 — CHECK PHOTOS that discs are inside and titles (Zeppelin/Floyd/Beatles)

LEAD — Royal Mint Winnie the Pooh & Friends coloured 50p proof collection in album; check if sterling silver proofs; 3; est. resale $400–800 if silver proofs (vs ~$15/coin base-metal); $125 ask — CHECK PHOTOS for "silver proof" COAs/capsules
